string.text: PSO-1M2 Sniper Scope

A fixed-magnification optical sight. The reticle is calibrated for long-range precision fire. For low-light conditions, the scope features an illuminated reticle that can be activated when needed. It mounts to a weapon using the standard Warsaw Pact–style dovetail rail.
PSO-1M2-1 Assault Scope

A fixed-magnification optical sight. The reticle is calibrated for medium-range engagements. For use in low-light environments, the scope includes an illuminated reticle that can be switched on when necessary. Commonly mounted on assault rifles equipped with the Warsaw Pact–standard dovetail rail.
1PN93-4 Night Sniper Scope

A fixed-magnification night vision scope designed for long-range precision fire. It mounts using the standard Warsaw Pact–style dovetail rail. Due to its height, it typically does not obstruct mechanical sights, allowing them to serve as backup aiming devices should the scope fail.
1PN93-1 Night Assault Scope
A fixed-magnification night vision scope calibrated for medium-range engagements. Commonly installed on assault rifles equipped with the standard Warsaw Pact–style dovetail rail.
1P78-1 Universal Scope
The 1P78-1 is a 2.8? optical sight intended for medium- and long-range engagements. It mounts on the standard dovetail rail. The reticle is suitable for both assault-rifle use and precision shooting.
Kobra Holographic Sight
The Kobra collimator sight (EKP-1S-03 variant) provides comfortable aiming under natural lighting. It uses a triangular aiming mark and mounts onto the standard Warsaw Pact–style dovetail rail.
PK-A Red Dot Sight

The PK-A collimator sight enables fast target acquisition under virtually any lighting conditions. The aiming mark is a simple dot. The sight can be mounted onto weapons equipped with a dovetail rail.
SUSAT Assault Sight

A British-designed 4? optical sight commonly used for accurate fire from light small arms at medium and long distances. It includes backup iron sights for use if the optical system fails. Installs on the special dovetail mount found on the L85.
Aimpoint CompM4s Red Dot Sight
A closed-type collimator sight from the Swedish company Aimpoint AB, designed for accurate shooting at short and medium ranges. The aiming mark is a dot. Installs on a Picatinny rail.
EOTech XPS3-0 Holographic Sight
A holographic weapon sight produced by the American company EOTech. The XPS3-0 model is highly compact, making it popular among stalkers. Installs on a Picatinny rail.
Elcan Specter DR 1x/4x Assault Sight

An optical sight by ELCAN Optical Technologies featuring switchable magnification (1x and 4x). Installs on a Picatinny rail. The reticle has adjustable illumination, and the sight includes backup mechanical aiming devices.
PN-23 Night Assault Scope
A compact, fixed-magnification (3x) night vision scope produced by NPZ (Novosibirsk Instrument-Making Plant). Installs on a Picatinny rail.
Rakurs-PM Assault Sight
The wide-angle Rakurs-PM optical sight increases shooting efficiency at point-blank ranges (up to 400 m) against moving and stationary targets. This variant is designed for mounting on a Weaver rail.
PU Hunting Scope
A 3.5x hunting scope intended for installation on shotguns equipped with a special bracket. Not compatible with other weapons.
PGO-7V Grenade Launcher Sight

A Soviet telescopic sight developed in the 1960s specifically for RPG-7 series launchers. While its impact on accuracy for inexperienced stalkers is limited (and high precision generally isn't required for grenade launchers), firing with the sight is much more convenient. Includes an illuminated reticle for use in low-light conditions.
PO 4x34 Optical Sight

A Soviet 4x optical sight designed for medium-range use. Known for its simplicity and reliability, though its limited adjustment options make it less popular among snipers. It is part of the standard equipment of the OTs-14 "Groza" complex and is most commonly used with it.
PB Suppressor Module
The forward module of the integral suppressor for the PB pistol (9x18 mm). Not compatible with other weapons.
5.56?45 Suppressor
The AAC M4-2000 suppressor is designed for use with most rifles and carbines chambered in 5.56x45 mm.
APB Suppressor
A suppressor for the APB pistol (9x18 mm). Not compatible with other weapons.
TGP-V Suppressor
A tactical suppressor-flash hider for 7.62 mm rifles, compatible with SVD-series sniper rifles.
TGP-A Suppressor
A 5.45 mm tactical suppressor-flash hider. Compatible with most AK-series rifles.
.45 ACP Pistol Suppressor
The BLACK BOX .45 suppressor produced by Advanced Armament Corp. Fits most .45 ACP pistols with a threaded barrel.
Hexagon 12K Sound Moderator
A shot-sound moderator from the Hexagon company, intended for 12-gauge carbines and shotguns.
5.7x28 Suppressor
This suppressor can be installed on the FN P90 submachine gun.
GEMTECH SFN57 Suppressor
A suppressor specifically designed for the FN Five-seveN pistol models equipped with a threaded barrel. Not compatible with other weapons.
9 mm "Bizon" Suppressor
A suppressor designed for the 9 mm Bizon-series submachine guns.
9x18 Pistol Suppressor
A universal suppressor for pistols chambered in 9x18 mm. Fits most models, though some may require a threaded barrel.
9x19 Pistol Suppressor
A universal suppressor for 9x19 mm pistols. Fits most models, though some may require a threaded barrel.
9x21 Pistol Suppressor
A suppressor for pistols chambered in 9x21 mm. Requires a threaded barrel for installation.
9x39 "Groza" Suppressor Module
A suppressor module from the OTs-14 "Groza" weapon system. The rubber casing allows the suppressor to be used as a forward grip when holding the weapon.
GP-25 "Koster"

A single-shot under-barrel grenade launcher for assault rifles used by Warsaw Pact countries. Features a double-action trigger, manual safety, and automatic firing lock when improperly mounted. Compatible with VOG-25 and VOG-25P rounds.
L123A2 UGL
An under-barrel grenade launcher designed specifically for the L85A2 rifle. Supports various NATO-standard 40 mm grenades.

A modified version of the single-shot M203 launcher with a barrel shortened by three inches and an adapter for Picatinny mounting. This mounting change greatly expanded the weapon’s adoption worldwide.
GP-5

A grenade-launcher module designed for use with the OTs-14 "Groza" weapon system. Based on the GP-25, incorporating several design changes. Notably, it uses a unified trigger for firing both grenades and standard ammunition. Due to its modified mounting interface, the module cannot be used with other weapons.
